agentPack.documentationModel: Mission / Project Charter -> Strategic Outcome -> Initiative -> Delivery Unit -> Build Unit

migrationNotes: Roadmap is a scheduling and dependency view, not permanent Initiative ownership.
Domains are persistent boundaries with many-to-many Initiative relationships.
Delivery Unit may collapse for small work.
Build Units are not necessarily independently deployable.
Generic project-planning Layer is legacy-compatible and should be classified before migration.
Execution surfaces should be selected from required confidence, validation, capability, and permission needs.
Prefer the least-cost eligible surface; do not weaken Definition of Done to save credits, quota, compute, licenses, or human effort.
Distinguish implemented-but-unverified work from execution-verified work.
LEAP help and semantic routing are available in managed AGENTS.md; optional native Skills require explicit installation and independent native tests.
Advisory team and delivery-capacity estimation reads project-designated external truth; AGENTS.md contains only pointers, not replicated allocations or individual performance history.
